title: Sāmaññam
text: 1.2. Sāvatthi || || 3. Sāmaññañca vo bhikkhave desissāmi sāmaññaphalāni ca || taṃ suṇātha || || 4. Katamañca bhikkhave sāmaññaṃ || || Ayam eva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo || || Seyyathīdaṃ || sammādiṭṭhi || la || sammāsamādhi || || Idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave sāmaññaṃ || || 5. Katamāni ca bhikkhave sāmaññaphalāni || || Sotāpattiphalaṃ sakadāgāmiphalam anāgāmiphalam arahattaphalaṃ || || Imāni vuccanti bhikkhave sāmaññaphalānī ti || ||
